about: Pooled human 1v1 duel reference (openmohaa-movement REPORT section 11 acceptance statistics, and section 14's pre-aim, corner and reaction from the first visible body part) for humanbot/eval/compare.py. Aggregates over all humans only: no alias, no per-person value.
